text:
leo (Product): FYI: FinReg wants a private pilot in ~3 weeks. They explicitly asked for HSM-backed keys and syslog encryption. We have a capacity squeeze (Beacon prewarm) the same week. Can infra/runtime/security map tradeoffs fast?

anya (Eng): do we have flexibility on the HSM requirement? engineering timeline hinges on attestation hooks + key rotation.

mike (Runtime): HSM path touches the signing flow and audit headers. Without HSM we can provide an API-compatible pilot with a feature-flag that disables attestation; perf difference negligible. Estimate: 4 dev days to wire the feature-flag + smoke tests.

tara (Infra): Capacity windows: Jun07 (Beacon) vs Jun21. If Beacon swaps to Jun21 we can run FinReg Jun07. Otherwise FinReg default to Jun21. I can make a provisional reservation but need product sign-off to displace Beacon.

sam (Security): HSM onboarding + compliance checks -> ~7 business days once questionnaire returned. KMS-only pilot (with documented limitation) is doable in 2-3 business days but legal needs a short addendum. Also need to validate encrypted logs pipeline.

leo (Product): Options I see: 1) ship KMS-pilot asap with documented limitations + schedule HSM rollout; 2) push pilot to Jun21 for HSM; 3) ask Beacon PO to swap windows. Which is fastest for customer to get a usable pilot?

anya (Eng): fastest = KMS-pilot (option 1). Risk: compliance team might reject it. Dev work minimal.

mike (Runtime): agree. I'll prepare a smoke harness and canary flow for KMS-pilot. ETA 3 days for harness + 1 ops day to run prewarm.

tara (Infra): I'll provision Jun21 slot provisional now and create a conditional reservation for Jun07 if Beacon moves. Runbook snippet: `reserver create --name finreg-pilot --slot Jun21 --gpus A100:2 --provisional`

res-bot: Reservation created: slot-finreg-Jun21 (provisional).

sam (Security): Sent questionnaire to FinReg contact; copying leo. If answered in 48h we can fast-track HSM but still likely need Jun21 for full attest flow.

leo (Product): Action list: leo->confirm Beacon PO can consider swap; tara->hold Jun21 and prepare conditional Jun07; mike->smoke harness for KMS fallback; anya->document minimal acceptance; sam->follow up questionnaire. Reconvene Mon 09:00 to finalize. :thumbsup:
